name: Le Creuset
desc: French-Belgian cookware maker best known for enamelled cast-iron pots, also producing many other cookware and bakeware lines.
capacity_detail: Revenue USD 850 million in 2025 (Wikipedia infobox); owned by Paul van Zuydam
markets: Premium cookware sold worldwide; founded and manufacturing in Fresnoy-le-Grand, France, with headquarters in Zug, Switzerland.
rationale: Heritage premium home brand with a famous colour identity; F1 hospitality and lifestyle audiences match its affluent, global gifting customer.

name: Atomy
desc: South Korean multi-level marketing company selling daily household goods, health foods and skincare such as HemoHIM and The Fame.
capacity_detail: Revenue KRW 1,061.5 billion in 2020 (about USD 780M at ~1,360 KRW/USD); shares held 25% each by Park Han-gil and three family members
markets: South Korea headquarters with offices across Asia-Pacific, Central Asia, Russia, Turkey, the UK, Germany, the USA, Canada and Mexico.
rationale: Large consumer direct-seller with offices on several continents; F1 hospitality could reward top distributors and lift brand awareness abroad.

name: CHIMEI Corporation
desc: Taiwanese performance-materials company and leading ABS resin maker, also producing synthetic rubbers, PMMA, polycarbonate and specialty chemicals.
capacity_detail: Revenue NTD 159.87 billion in 2017 (about USD 5.0bn at ~32 TWD/USD); part of the privately held CHIMEI Group
markets: Plastics and rubber materials made in Tainan, Zhenjiang and Zhangzhou and supplied to manufacturers internationally.
rationale: Materials supplier to automotive and electronics makers; F1 offers a B2B showcase for engineering plastics and client hospitality.

name: Sae-A Trading
desc: South Korean clothing manufacturer producing garments in Central America, Haiti and Asia for US and European retailers and brands.
capacity_detail: Sales USD 1.6 billion in 2015 per company data cited on Wikipedia; listed as privately held on its UN Global Compact participant page
markets: Factories in Costa Rica, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Indonesia, Vietnam, Cambodia and Haiti; customers mainly US mass retailers, some in Europe and Asia.
rationale: B2B garment maker selling to global brands; F1 hospitality could support client relationships, though consumer brand value is limited.

name: ZURU
desc: Toy and consumer-goods company founded by the New Zealand Mowbray siblings, making brands such as Bunch O Balloons and X-Shot.
capacity_detail: More than USD 400 million annual sales (Forbes, 2019); Forbes Australia (Nov 2025) says revenue tracking around $4.5 billion this year; siblings own it, no outside funding
markets: Toys sold in 120 countries including every major US retailer; based in Hong Kong with factories in China.
rationale: Fast-growing global consumer brand house selling to families; F1's young fan growth and Mattel's and LEGO's F1 deals show category fit.

name: Green SM (GSM)
desc: Vietnamese all-electric taxi, ride-hailing and electric car rental company operating VinFast vehicles, founded by Pham Nhat Vuong in 2023.
capacity_detail: Net revenue over VND 16,000 billion in 2025 (about USD 610M at ~26,300 VND/USD), up 125% year on year; Pham Nhat Vuong holds 95%
markets: Vietnam, with subsidiaries in Laos, Indonesia, the Philippines, India, Kazakhstan and Denmark for electric taxi and car rental services.

signals.ipo: Preparing an IPO, listing venue undisclosed, possible valuation about USD 20bn (Apr 2026; https://bbw.vn/vingroup-dat-muc-tieu-loi-nhuan-ky-luc-he-lo-ke-hoach-ipo-gsm-tai-dai-hoi-co-dong-57462.html)

rationale: Expanding EV mobility brand entering new countries ahead of an IPO; F1's sustainability push and Asian races offer international brand visibility.
